verdict.rationale: Box's own AI capabilities produce insights from user content: summarizing files, asking questions about them, extracting metadata, and getting answers over curated Box Hub content. The product site also claims in-product AI co-creation. However, the evidence is mostly API-centric, and nothing documents proactive AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, so coverage of the story is incomplete. missing for 10: documented proactive suggestions/recommendations, detailed first-party docs of the in-product (end-user UI) AI insight experience, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Use the Box AI API to ask questions, extract metadata, and summarize files stored in Box.
Index curated content in a Box Hub and get answers with Box AI.
Summarize, extract, generate, and query content with enterprise permissions intact.
Access, share, edit, and co-create content with AI while accelerating productivity.
